title: Gluten-Free Lamb Shepherd's Pie
summary: A classic British shepherd’s pie with a rich lamb and vegetable filling under a buttery mashed potato crust. Savoury, comforting, and ideal for a cosy dinner.
steps: Put the potatoes in a large pan, cover with cold water, add a pinch of salt, and bring to the boil. Simmer for 15–20 minutes until completely tender.
While the potatoes cook, heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the onion and carrots and cook for 6–8 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic and lamb mince, breaking the meat up with a spoon, and cook for 6–8 minutes until browned all over.
Stir in the tomato paste, thyme, rosemary, black pepper, and 1 teaspoon of the salt. Cook for 1 minute, then add the water and simmer for 8–10 minutes until the filling is thick and glossy.
Stir in the peas and cook for 2 minutes, then taste and adjust the seasoning. Spoon the filling into a medium baking dish.
Drain the potatoes well and return them to the pan. Add the butter and milk, then mash until smooth. Season with the remaining salt.
Spread the mashed potato over the lamb filling, roughing up the surface with a fork so it will brown nicely.
Bake at 200°C for 20–25 minutes until the top is golden and the filling is bubbling around the edges. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
